mission.name: idea-garnet-l2a-browser
mission.tagline: Prove the committed Garnet browser runtime, denial boundary, package reproducibility, and human-plus-machine capability verdict without promoting launch claims by prose.
mission.northStar: A clean browser loads only committed package bytes and renders real run, check, and capability-diff results without a network fetch or Node-only execution path; A browser attempt to use denied process authority rejects with a non-success exit class and a visible diagnostic; Two clean builds from the same committed inputs produce byte-identical browser package files and provenance; The readiness reporter promotes browser status only after validating the committed package and browser proof; Capability diff renders a one-glance human verdict and a versioned structured machine verdict from the same adapter result

policies.notes: review until dogfood band 5 is routine; then auto.

phases.title: Package materialization
phases.goal: Extend the hermetic no-publish probe into a fail-closed materializer and commit the exact browser package with canonical provenance.

gates.title: Two clean builds are byte-identical to the committed package
gates.notes: Two fresh offline builds matched each other and the committed package byte-for-byte.

phases.title: Live adapter and page integration
phases.goal: Wire run_source, check_source, and diff_caps_source from committed Wasm bytes into a usable editor page with explicit result surfaces.

gates.title: Static live-page and adapter contracts pass
gates.notes: Six browser-surface contracts and the legacy static-preset readiness gate passed.

phases.title: Playwright success and denial traps
phases.goal: Prove in a clean browser under 30 seconds that run, check, and diff work and denied process authority fails closed with a visible diagnostic.

gates.title: Clean-browser success and fail-closed denial proof passes
gates.notes: Clean Chromium completed run, check, capability diff, and declared-proc denial in 2,637 ms from six committed requests with no external or untracked fetch; the proof binds ten exact runtime, harness, and locked-install inputs.

phases.title: Evidence-backed reporter promotion
phases.goal: Make scripts/garnet_wasm_readiness.py validate package provenance and browser proof before reporting browser readiness or passing its gate.

gates.title: Wasm readiness reporter regressions pass
gates.notes: Thirteen reporter regressions passed, including malformed-proof and stale-runtime-digest fail-closed behavior.

gates.title: Evidence-backed browser readiness gate passes
gates.notes: Reporter schema v3 returned browser_package_valid, browser_proof_valid, and browser_ready true with no blockers.

phases.title: Human and machine capability verdict
phases.goal: Render a one-glance capability expansion verdict and expose the same decision as versioned structured JSON for agent reviewers.

gates.title: Browser proof validates matching human and machine verdicts
gates.notes: Three proof-contract tests pinned the shared human and machine expansion decision plus fail-closed denial semantics.

risks.title: A polished editor could accidentally certify a Node path, a warning-only denial, or package bytes that were not committed and reproducible.
The existing Studio development graph contains a high Vite advisory for Windows dev-server path handling.
risks.note: Production npm audit is clean and W-PLAY does not start Vite; dependency remediation remains a separately scoped follow-up.

risks.title: Browser proof records the Chrome version but does not pin the selected executable hash.
risks.note: Final independent review classified this as a replay-hermeticity limitation, not a failure of the committed-package or observed-browser claims.

prLog.notes: Corrected dogfood evidence, agent contracts, rustfmt, clippy, and Ubuntu/Windows/macOS cargo tests all passed on the synchronized head. Exact links are committed; the evidence-only link commit must rerun before ready-for-review transition.

nextActions: Push the exact-link evidence commit and require its fresh PR #509 dependency chain to finish green.
After the evidence-only head is green, mark PR #509 ready for Jon's human merge without merging it.
